subject.title: fix(ci): resolve merge conflict markers in redact.test.ts after redactSensitive config change

question: Should `logging.redactSensitive: off` be allowed to disable Control UI tool-payload redaction and expose credentials, or must tool payloads retain their current independent redaction boundary?
rationale: The existing test and comment describe an intentional distinction between log-output configuration and UI-facing tool payload redaction; changing that boundary affects credential exposure and needs maintainer intent rather than contributor inference.

options.title: Preserve UI tool redaction
options.body: Remove the logging-redaction semantic changes and retain the existing tools-mode protection, leaving this PR limited to any real conflict cleanup.

options.title: Sponsor a separate exposure policy
options.body: Move the behavior change to a separate proposal with explicit security review, configuration contract, upgrade analysis, and focused proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve UI tool redaction
recommendation.body: Remove the logging-redaction semantic changes and retain the existing tools-mode protection, leaving this PR limited to any real conflict cleanup.
